name: Albania — employment income

changelog.summary: Months with leave and partial months: contributions are on the pay for the days worked in a month employment starts or ends, or with sickness (from day 15) or maternity benefit (VKM 77/2015 IV.6); other months, including agreed unpaid leave, keep the minimum-wage floor (II.3). Before, a month below the minimum wage with leave or a start or end was refused until a minimum base was entered. The employer's first 14 sick days are confirmed as taxed and insured like pay (I.1 i)).

Statutory sick pay as a leave pay rule: days 1-14 of a medical report at 80% of the wage, paid by the employer (Labour Code art. 130), then unpaid as social insurance pays; applied where the workspace has no sick leave rule of its own. Before, sick days were paid in full unless a rule was added.

Leave pay rules documented, no change in amounts: pay the employer keeps for sick days (the first 14 days of a medical report) is wage; days the rule leaves unpaid, which social insurance pays, are outside every base (law 29/2023 art. 11 a)). A month with leave below the minimum wage still asks for the minimum base, now saying so.
2026: minimum wage 50,000 and maximum social-insurance base 186,416 ALL; law 29/2023 employment tax (arts. 22, 24) and VKM 77/2015 contribution rates.

labour-code-art-130.title: Kodi i Punës neni 130 as described by payroll guides (AlProfit Consult, 'Përfitimi nga raportet mjekësore për paaftësi në punë'): 'The first 14 days are paid by the employer, at no less than 80% of the wage'; from day 15 social insurance (ISSH) pays 70% (80% after ten years of coverage) of the net daily average of the last six months

employee.description: Whether the employee signed the personal-status declaration (law 29/2023 art. 66) with this employer; only then is the monthly personal deduction applied (art. 65)
Contract length for social-insurance rates (VKM 77/2015 pts 3-5)
Whether the employee also works for another employer (VKM 77/2015 pt 15)
Minimum contribution base in ALL replacing the minimum wage — for partial months, where the floor must be prorated

monthlyEmploymentTax.description: Monthly employment tax on the base after the personal deduction: 13% up to 170,000, 23% above (law 29/2023 art. 24; Instruction 26/2023 pt 24)

steps.message: Albanian payroll (listëpagesa) is monthly: the pay period must be a whole calendar month
Pre-tax deductions are not supported by this template: the law 29/2023 art. 20 private-pension deduction is not modelled
The employee works under half time (under 87 hours a month) but contractHours says MORE_THAN_87_HOURS; set contractHours
The employee has other employment and earns below the minimum wage here; VKM 77/2015 pt 15 splits contributions across employers in a way this template does not model

leavePay.note: The employer pays at least 80% of the wage for the first 14 days of a medical report; from day 15 the Social Insurance Institute pays, outside payroll. A contract or collective agreement paying more needs a workspace rule.

limitations: Monthly payroll calendars whose periods are whole calendar months, paid in ALL.

Contributions are on at least the minimum wage (VKM 77/2015 II.3), except in a month employment starts or ends, or with sickness benefit (days a leave pay rule leaves unpaid) or maternity leave, where they are on the pay for the days worked (IV.6). Employees below the minimum wage at one of several employers (pt 15) are refused unless a minimumContributionBase is set.
The art. 20 private-pension deduction and the annual-return deductions (children, education) are not applied; employees with tenant pre-tax deductions are refused.

Leave pay rules: pay kept for sick days is the employer's payment for the first 14 days of a medical report (at least 80% of the wage, Labour Code art. 130), with contributions and tax as on pay (VKM 77/2015 I.1 i)). Days the rule leaves unpaid are paid by social insurance (ISSH) outside payroll and are not taxed (law 29/2023 art. 11 a)); social insurance and maternity benefits are not paid through this template.
Social insurance across several employers is computed per employer on its own pay (capped at the maximum each); the refund of the excess by the Social Insurance Institute is outside payroll.
The maximum social-insurance base (186,416 ALL) comes from the tax administration's 2026 notice, since removed from its website, and Boga & Associates' alert; not from a gazette text.
Amounts are rounded to 0.01 ALL, half up, line by line; rounding to whole lek on the e-payroll declaration is not modelled.
Status LAW_DERIVED: the tax amounts of three cases reproduce Instruction 26/2023's worked examples; contribution amounts are derived from the cited acts.

testCases.name: official example: 230,000 with the declaration
testCases.evidence: Instruction 26/2023 pt 24: (2,760,000 - 360,000) a year taxed 2,040,000 x 13% + 360,000 x 23% = 265,200 + 82,800 (the instruction misprints the sum as 358,000; it is 348,000) = 29,000 a month.
